fullDescription: A premium 'Midnight Editorial' portfolio style designed for creative professionals, gaming agencies, and SaaS brands. This design utilizes a deep midnight black #050505 background with high-energy coral #FF6B50 accents. It features massive responsive typography (up to 14vw), a dual navigation system (fixed top and glassmorphic floating bottom), and a staggered bento-grid inspired layout for work showcases. Key aesthetics include minimalist borders, grayscale social proof components, and subtle floating animations, creating a high-end, sophisticated mood for content creators.
prompt:
## Resumo
An editorial-grade dark mode portfolio featuring oversized typography, a dual navigation strategy, and a high-contrast coral accent system. The style blends minimalist Swiss-style layout principles with modern gaming-culture energy.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a background of #050505 and primary accent of #FF6B50. Typography must use 'Satoshi Variable' (or a similar geometric sans-serif like Inter). Hero headlines should be massive (13vw to 14vw), italic-free, with letter-spacing of -0.05em and line-height of 0.85-0.9. Navigation should include a fixed top bar and a floating bottom dock with backdrop-filter: blur(12px), rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.8), and a 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) border. Interactive elements should use cubic-bezier transitions for hover effects, including scale(1.05) on images and background color shifts from #1A1A1A to #FFFFFF for buttons. Selection color must be #FF6B50 with white text.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Fixed Top Navigation
A fixed full-width header (px-6, py-6). Left side features a logo (a 32px rounded square, black text on white background) and a hidden-on-mobile link list in #888888. Right side features a text link and a button styled with a #333333 border, #1A1A1A background, and white text that inverts on hover.

### Floating Bottom Dock
A centered floating dock (bottom-8) using a glassmorphism effect (blur: 12px, background: rgba(17,17,17,0.8)). It contains a series of icon buttons separated by a vertical #333333 border, followed by a primary CTA button in #FF6B50 with black bold text (uppercase, tracking-wide).

### Hero Section
A full-height (100vh) section with a radial gradient background (#1A1A1A to #050505). Center text is massive (13vw) and says '/thumbnails'. Bottom-left includes a social proof stack: three 40px grayscale avatars overlapping (-space-x-4) and two lines of #888888 text. Bottom-right features a single email link with a persistent bottom border that changes to #FF6B50 on hover.

### Benefits Bento Grid
A 2-column grid section. Column 1: A #111111 rounded-3xl (2.5rem) card containing oversized typography ('Higher CTR.') in white and grey. Column 2: A vibrant gradient card (emerald to blue) featuring a floating UI mockup. The mockup should have a '100 DAYS!' badge in #FF6B50 tilted at -12 degrees.

### Staggered Work Gallery
A 2-column project grid with a significant top margin for the second column (md:mt-24) to create a staggered effect. Each project is a 16:9 aspect ratio container with a grayscale image at 60% opacity that becomes full color and scales 1.05x on hover. Titles are in 3xl bold white text with a category label in #666666 (10px, bold, 0.2em tracking).

### Impact Footer
A footer featuring a massive two-line text block ('CRAFT MORE.') at 14vw font size. Includes a vertical stack for contact info and a horizontal row of 56px circular social icons with 1px borders (#333333) that lift (-translate-y-2) and invert color on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Floating Gaming Badge — A slanted, high-contrast badge used for gaming thumbnails or highlights.
Create a div with background-color: #FF6B50, padding: 8px 24px, border-radius: 8px. Font: Black, extra-bold, italic. Transform: skew-x(-12deg). Add an animation 'float' that moves the component translateY(-10px) over 4 seconds with an ease-in-out curve.

### Glassmorphic Dock — A high-end floating navigation container.
A container with background: rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.8), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), and border-radius: 1rem. Internal buttons should have a padding of 12px and a hover background of #222222 with transition-all duration-300.

## Notas Especiais
Maintain strict adherence to the #050505 background; do not use pure black #000000. Ensure the 'Satoshi' font tracking is tight to give it the editorial look. The coral #FF6B50 must only be used for the primary CTA, the 'pulse' indicator, and high-impact hover states. Images should defaults to grayscale or low-saturation (opacity 60%) and only reveal full color on active interaction to maintain the 'Midnight' mood.

style.description: The style essence is 'Midnight Editorial'—sophisticated, dark, and bold. It relies on the Satoshi Variable font family for a modern, geometric look. The color palette is strictly controlled: #050505 (Background), #FF6B50 (Coral Accent), #EBEBEB (Primary Text), and varying shades of grey (#888888, #666666, #1A1A1A) for hierarchy. Layouts use large negative space, tight tracking (-0.05em), and 16:9 aspect ratios for imagery. Transitions are smooth (duration-700) with subtle floating micro-interactions.
